items.recommendWhy: Amber Terrarium suits a Field Manual landmark entry while capturing both the warm palette and the sealed ecosystem of ME MINIX 3.
items.decisionWhy: This is the unique anchor set piece defining the ME MINIX 3 Userspace layer.

proposals.why: References the TCP port on which AMT listens for management traffic even while the host OS is asleep.

proposals.name: Absentee Desk

items.recommendWhy: Port 16992 is dry, immediately recognizable to systems readers, and captures the uncanny persistence of AMT.

items.depicts: Three miniature ochre and amber rectangular towers standing side by side, the centre one taller with two dark windows.

proposals.name: Miniature Skyline

items.recommendWhy: Pocket Precinct keeps the urban userspace metaphor intact at miniature scale without leaning too hard on a proper-noun joke.
items.decisionWhy: Distinct miniature-skyline prop unique to the ME MINIX 3 Userspace layer.

items.depicts: An ochre-bordered black panel displaying one bright amber square beside one dim brown square.

proposals.name: Reincarnation Server

proposals.name: Lazarus Panel

items.recommendWhy: MINIX 3's real name for rs is already dry, iconic, and needs no embellishment.
items.decisionWhy: Unique prop depicting MINIX 3's signature process-recovery server.
